svg.title: Your AI Agent Needs a Database. Give It One in Five Seconds
svg.desc: A flat three step provisioning flow: a coding agent runs npx create-db@latest --json and gets a real Prisma Postgres database at db.prisma.io that deletes itself after 24 hours. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism yellow accent, no headline.

g.text: claim it to keep it, free
